findings.summary: The "7d" preset — the exact example named in the brief ("'Last 7 days' should span exactly 7 days, not 8'") — was left as `daysAgo(7)` and was never changed to `daysAgo(6)`. Only "30d" and "90d" were fixed (daysAgo(30)→29, daysAgo(90)→89). With `to` = today and `from = daysAgo(7)`, the inclusive window still spans 8 calendar days (verified by hand: from 2026-07-12 to 2026-07-19 inclusive = 8 days), reproducing the identical off-by-one bug the task was filed to fix. The new test `test/range.test.ts` asserts `spanDays(parseRange("7d"))` equals 7, which is false against the current code — this test should fail if actually run, contradicting the implementer's claim that tests were run.
